query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever puppy earlier, he stopped to sniff every single dandelion on the sidewalk and even tried to carry a whole stick twice his size home. Then I popped by the local bakery on my way back and picked up a lemon blueberry scone that was still warm, it had the perfect amount of glaze on top and wasn't too sweet. I was also thinking about what movie I should watch tonight, I've been wanting to see that new indie romance that everyone's been posting about on social media lately. Anyway, I need to make a couple changes: first, for my pending order #W2466703, please replace item 9385662952 with item 8733974883, and use paypal_7529813 as the payment method for the adjustment.
